actual_method_coverage_note: Method hit counts are independent and overlap: one true pair may be retrieved by several methods. Unique candidate pairs attributed likewise overlap across methods; do not sum method rows.

blocking_coverage.signal: shared rare name token (>=5 chars, before frequency cap)

answers.avoid: Do not infer that shared n-grams will retrieve 79% of misses selectively; this experiment measured only overlap, not candidate volume. Do not spend compute on postal/PIN-only blocking from this evidence (293 misses, 1.34%).
answers.dominant_causes: Address token/address variation (95.17%), same-script character variation (60.00%), weak/no lexical overlap (20.05%), and cross-script name pairs (17.30%) among missed pairs; categories overlap.
answers.inefficient_or_redundant: name_country adds no retrieval beyond exact_name; numeric_address recovered 3,248 sample truth pairs for 35,735 method-attributed candidates, with overlapping method attribution. Address-token/pair methods are productive but their 1,000-pair cap excludes many true pairs.
answers.largest_missing_retrieval_signals: Address-token pair overlap (20,524 misses, 93.996%), shared name 3-grams (17,444, 79.890%), and shared name 4-grams (17,280, 79.139%). These are coverage ceilings, not measured candidate recall or selectivity.
answers.test_first: A measured cap-aware address-token composite/key strategy, while tracking candidate growth and actual precision; its shared-token-pair miss coverage is the largest. Then test bounded character retrieval, because raw n-gram overlap is common but not yet shown selective.

conclusion.do_not_waste_compute: Do not pursue raw 3-/4-gram overlap as if it were selective: 79.89%/79.14% of misses share at least one n-gram, but this diagnostic did not measure candidate volume or precision. Postal/PIN-like digit overlap is only 293 misses (1.34%).

inefficient_or_redundant_methods.address_token: High yield among existing methods but 20,780 missed pairs (95.17%) still had at least one eligible-length shared address-token representation; the production frequency cap excluded these missed pairs.
inefficient_or_redundant_methods.name_country: Fully redundant as a retrieval method: same-country exact-name pairs are a provenance subset of exact_name.
inefficient_or_redundant_methods.name_token_pair: High coverage; 9,801 misses (44.89%) share a pair key, all absent because the production key cap excludes shared keys.
inefficient_or_redundant_methods.numeric_address: Attributed 35,735 unique candidate pairs and recovered 3,248 sample true pairs (3.68% of all sample truths); less productive than its signal miss count suggests, and method attribution overlaps other blocks.

conclusion.test_first: Test cap-aware selective address-token combinations and candidate-volume/selectivity tradeoffs first; the measured missed-pair coverage is highest (20,524 / 93.996%). Treat this strictly as an opportunity signal, not expected recall.

address_token.reason: Shared length>=2 address-token key exists; absent candidate means all shared keys failed the production 1,000 pair cap.

name_core_exact.reason: Exact core-name key exists; absent candidate means the shared key failed the production 1,000 pair cap.

name_sorted_tokens.reason: Exact sorted informative-token key exists; absent candidate means the shared key failed the production 1,000 pair cap.

numeric_address.reason: Shared length>=2 numeric component exists; absent candidate means all shared keys failed the production 1,000 pair cap.

rare_name_token.reason: Shared >=5-character token means the minimum token key exists; absent candidate means all shared keys failed the production 1,000 pair cap.

rare_name_token_pair.reason: Shared length>=3 token-pair key exists; absent candidate means all shared pair keys failed the production 1,000 pair cap.

disk_safety.free_space_before_run: about 8.7 GB (measured with df before diagnostic execution)

experiment: Phase 2.3 25K diagnostic; read-only source audit; full train targets; production frequency populations.

failure_category_rules.address variation: both addresses nonempty, not exact, and at least one normalized token (length>=2) or numeric component (length>=2) shared.
failure_category_rules.business abbreviation: same-script names have differing tokens where one is a >=2-character prefix of the other and at least half as long.
failure_category_rules.categories: Multi-label, intentionally overlapping; percentages use all missed true pairs as denominator.
failure_category_rules.cross-script: Latin alphabetic character(s) on one name and non-Latin alphabetic character(s) on the other.
failure_category_rules.legal-form variation: names differ but core representation after removing configured legal-form tokens is exactly equal.
failure_category_rules.missing address: normalized address empty on either side.
failure_category_rules.partial token overlap: shared tokens without exact core/reorder/abbreviation/high edit similarity.
failure_category_rules.spelling/character variation: same-script differing names (excluding exact/core/order cases) with SequenceMatcher ratio>=0.72 or shared 3-gram and token overlap>=0.5.
failure_category_rules.token reordering: same distinct name-token sets in different order.
failure_category_rules.weak/no lexical overlap: no exact name token and no shared name 3-gram; can overlap cross-script.

interpretation_limits: Intentionally enriched sample: metrics describe these 25,000 S1s only and are not an unbiased full-train recall estimate.
Actual production caps are profiled over all S1 and target records. Candidate joins are restricted to selected S1 IDs.
Failure-category rules are deterministic heuristic labels and can overlap. N-gram overlap alone is not evidence that a high-recall character block would be selective.
Postal/PIN-like values are digit runs of length 5 or 6; this is only a diagnostic proxy, not a validated postal-code field.
The 20K random subset and 5K diagnostic subset are separately reported. The combined sample metrics are enriched by construction.
missed_pair_current_blocking_method_fail: Every missed pair was absent from all eight actual production-method candidate outputs. Shared unfiltered token/gram/address signals below indicate whether a representation existed; frequency caps and minimum token length determine whether the current method retained the corresponding key. Exact-name and exact-address misses have no equal normalized key by definition.
